name: The Hunter's Path
label: Quest
description: In Durotar, The Hunter's Path sends young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill. There, Thotar teaches them to bind wild predators.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, The Hunter's Path sends young orc and troll hunters to Razor Hill. There, Thotar teaches them to bind wild predators.

In Durotar, young hunters learn to track prey with bow and cunning. Following trails through red clay canyons and harsh scrubland teaches patience. To master the hunter's way in the Horde, they must also learn to bond with the land's wild beasts. When class trainers judge a student ready, they direct them to Razor Hill.

Thotar waits at Razor Hill, where he teaches young hunters how to subdue Durotar's fierce beasts without breaking their spirit. Learning from him begins the path to traveling the wilderness with a loyal companion.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, it is time for you to begin your training.
